# Qari Abdul Mateen Shaheen — Holy Quran Recitation

> Free online Quran reader and audio player featuring the beautiful recitation of Qari Abdul Mateen Shaheen.

## About This Site

This website (qariabdulmateenshaheen.com) is dedicated to making the Holy Quran accessible to everyone. It provides:

- Complete Arabic text of all 114 surahs of the Holy Quran
- English translation (Ahmed Ali)
- Urdu translation (Maududi)
- High-quality audio recitation by Qari Abdul Mateen Shaheen
- Ayah-by-ayah display with bookmarking and favourites

## About Qari Abdul Mateen Shaheen

Qari Abdul Mateen Shaheen is a renowned Quran reciter (Qari) known for his melodious and precise recitation of the Holy Quran. This site hosts his complete recitation of all 114 surahs.

## Content

- Language: Arabic (Quran text), English, Urdu
- Surahs: 1 (Al-Fatiha) through 114 (An-Nas)
- Total Ayahs: 6,236
- Audio: MP3 recitation per surah
- Free to use, no login required
